# How much of what you earn should you set aside for tax?

> Free Singapore freelancer tax calculator: enter income and expenses to see income tax after earned income relief, a MediSave flag and how much of every invoice to set aside. Runs in your browser; nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.

## Pages

- [The tool](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/oss-monorepo/sg-freelancer-tax-set-aside-calculator/)
